verdict.rationale: Statsig publishes extensive first-party SDK documentation covering client/server SDKs, on-device eval SDKs, deterministic evaluation, quickstart integration guides (e.g., StatsigProvider), and AI-specific integrations (OpenAI, Azure AI, prompt versioning) that let developers build against official SDKs rather than raw HTTP APIs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK reliability across languages and a comprehensive list of all supported language SDKs.
